summary: ```markdown # CLO 2024.2 - Geometry Extrusion Direction ## Introduction In the 2024.2 version, the settings related to the thickness of the board are consolidated, including the introduction of new functions. This update aims to enhance the overall operation and user experience. ## Property Editor Enhancements A new set of categories has been added to the property editor. The thickness rendering function has been relocated to allow for a relatively large rendering thickness. This adjustment ensures that the thickness of the board is visible only when it is positioned on the surface of dense textures. ### Squeeze Out Direction Option The direction of the board's thickness can now be set. The default squeeze-out direction is "All," meaning the thickness will be displayed on both the front and back of the board. Users can change the direction to "Before" or "After," which allows the thickness to exist only on one side of the board. - **Display Options:** - Open the default display to show the grid. - Options to hide the front or back of the board are available. ### Sewing Area Control Control over the sewing area is improved. The grid on the side of the board indicates that the default setting is closed, which means the sides of two boards have been sewn together. The grid in the sewing area is related to the total thickness of the board. - **Total Thickness Details:** - The total thickness is defined by the thickness of the material itself. - The material window allows users to select the corresponding fabric. ## Thickness Specifications In the property editor, users can find the thickness specifications at the bottom. For instance, a material may have a thickness of 0.5. - **Thickness Selection:** - If the total thickness is equal across panels, the side mesh of the seam allowance will be hidden. - If a panel's thickness is set to 10, users can observe that the side mesh of the seam allowance is hidden when the panel is slightly pulled. ### Adjusting Seam Allowance Users have the option to open or close the display of the seam allowance. The mesh of the side seam allowance can be displayed or hidden based on user preference. - **Equal Total Thickness:** - If the total thickness is not equal, selecting a panel and increasing the thickness of its seam allowance will keep the side mesh visible. - When the panel's thickness is adjusted to match that of the seam allowance, the side mesh may also be affected. ## Panel and Fabric Adjustments Users can adjust the fabric thickness as needed. For example, changing the fabric thickness from 0.5 to 0.6 will yield similar effects as before, allowing users to freely display or hide the side mesh. - **Curve Adjustments:** - The side mesh can be adjusted by changing the value of the curve. - Users can turn off the display mesh to facilitate curve adjustments. ### Detail Level Control The detail level controls the number of divisions in the side mesh. Users can change this value between 1 and 10. ## Application Examples ### Single Line Pocket To create the effect of a single-line pocket, the lip panel of the left pocket can be adjusted to face outward using the output direction function. - **Setting Directions:** - The lip panel faces inward, while the body panel is set to face outward, resulting in a raised body effect. ### T-Shirt Effects For t-shirts, the output direction of the lip panel can be set to the back, while the front of the t-shirt is set to the front. This allows users to see the effect from the side. - **Seam Line Adjustments:** - Users can change the seam line of the lip to create desired visual effects. ## Shoulder Strap Adjustments When working with shoulder straps, adjusting the conflict thickness can optimize performance. - **Squeeze Direction:** - Change the squeeze direction of the shoulder strap plate to one side of the model body to improve fit. ### Final Adjustments If unsure about the front and back of the plate, users can switch to a black and white view for clarity. The fabric settings can be adjusted to maintain the desired appearance on both sides of the shoulder strap. ## Conclusion The CLO 2024.2 update enhances user control over geometry extrusion direction, thickness rendering, and overall panel management. These features enable users to explore new creative possibilities in garment design. ```
